name: Pixel Matrix Display
description: A glowing dot-matrix display that powers on in a sweep, then dissolves between a marquee, a live clock, a mic-driven equaliser, a heartbeat and an orbit.

props.name: text
props.description: Marquee text. A–Z, 0–9 and : . - / % + render; trailing spaces add a gap.

props.name: color
props.description: Lit dot colour, the display’s one accent; also tints the bloom, the caption’s progress line and the live mic dot.

props.name: chrome
props.description: Show the scene caption and prev/pause/next controls.

props.name: microphone
props.description: Offer a 'Use mic' toggle that drives the equaliser from live microphone levels (opt-in, asks permission, stops on toggle or unmount).

props.name: scene
props.description: Show this scene. It must be one of `scenes`. Jumps there when the value changes and pauses auto-advance, so the pause button reads Resume; Resume continues cycling, and prev and next still step.

props.name: onSceneChange
props.description: Called whenever the shown scene changes (auto-advance, prev/next, the mic or `scene`), so a host can keep `scene` in sync.
